background: Born and raised in Flushing, Queens, in a Hui Chinese Muslim family above her parents' stationery shop; she learned to translate invoices before she learned to drive.
regionalHistory: Her parents came from Xi'an in different waves, carrying Mandarin family stories about mosque courtyards, rail journeys, and rebuilding a life in New York.
culturalBaseline: Culturally rooted and selectively observant; she fasts much of Ramadan, joins family prayers, and is still deciding what adulthood will look like.
sensitivities: East Asian Muslims treated as invisible
fluency or observance used as an authenticity test
